task_description: Predicting the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) overpotential at 10 mA cm⁻² for undiscovered perovskite oxide compositions to accelerate the discovery of high-performance alkaline OER electrocatalysts, specifically targeting low-overpotential materials among quaternary, quinary, and hexanary perovskite systems with A-site (e.g., Pr/Sr) and B-site (e.g., Co/Fe/Mn) cation combinations.

datasets.db_description: A manually curated dataset comprising 140 perovskite oxide entries (94 OER-specific and 46 non-OER), including material compositions (A- and B-site cations), oxygen vacancy concentrations, chemical valence state distributions, synthesis methods (predominantly sol-gel), and experimentally measured OER overpotentials at 10 mA cm⁻² in alkaline electrolytes (1 M KOH). This dataset supports training and transfer learning of the ensemble regression model to predict OER activity for novel compositions.
